# GitHub Labels

A consistent label taxonomy for issues and PRs.

## Type

| Label            | Colour    | Meaning                              |
| ---------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `type: feature`  | `#1d76db` | New capability                       |
| `type: bug`      | `#d73a4a` | Defect                               |
| `type: refactor` | `#5319e7` | Internal change, no behaviour change |
| `type: docs`     | `#0075ca` | Documentation                        |
| `type: test`     | `#0e8a16` | Tests only                           |
| `type: chore`    | `#cfd3d7` | Tooling / deps / maintenance         |

## Priority

| Label                | Meaning         |
| -------------------- | --------------- |
| `priority: critical` | Drop everything |
| `priority: high`     | Next up         |
| `priority: medium`   | Normal          |
| `priority: low`      | Nice to have    |

## Status

| Label                  | Meaning              |
| ---------------------- | -------------------- |
| `status: triage`       | Needs assessment     |
| `status: ready`        | Ready to work        |
| `status: in-progress`  | Being worked on      |
| `status: blocked`      | Waiting on something |
| `status: needs-review` | PR awaiting review   |

## Area

`area: accounts`, `area: supplier`, `area: buyer`, `area: documents`,
`area: verification`, `area: activity`, `area: notifications`, `area: rfq`,
`area: orders`, `area: matching`, `area: dashboard`, `area: infra`, `area: ci`.

## Other

`dependencies`, `security`, `good first issue`, `breaking-change`.
